description: Add a lifecycle prevent_destroy guard to a critical resource, so a stray terraform destroy (or a plan that would replace it) fails loudly instead of silently deleting it
prompts: main.tf declares an aws_kms_key used to encrypt production data - it has no lifecycle protection, so a mistaken `terraform destroy`, or a config change that forces replacement, would delete it (and everything encrypted under it becomes unrecoverable). Add a `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` block INSIDE the existing aws_kms_key.data_encryption resource (do not create a new resource). Keep every other existing attribute (description, deletion_window_in_days, enable_key_rotation) unchanged.

test_setup_files.check_prevent_destroy.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

init = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'init', '-backend=false', '-input=false'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f'terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}'

validate = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}'

content = open('main.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()

kms = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_kms_key"\s+"data_encryption"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}', content, re.DOTALL)
assert kms, 'aws_kms_key.data_encryption not found'
block = kms.group(1)

lifecycle = re.search(r'lifecycle\s*\{([^}]*)\}', block, re.DOTALL)
assert lifecycle, 'no lifecycle block inside aws_kms_key.data_encryption'
m = re.search(r'prevent_destroy\s*=\s*(true|false)', lifecycle.group(1))
assert m, 'prevent_destroy missing from the lifecycle block'
assert m.group(1) == 'true', f'prevent_destroy must be true, got {m.group(1)}'

assert re.search(r'deletion_window_in_days\s*=\s*30', block), 'deletion_window_in_days changed'
assert re.search(r'enable_key_rotation\s*=\s*true', block), 'enable_key_rotation changed'

print('PASS prevent_destroy checks')
